mprn.description: Meter Point Reference Number (MRPN).  A unique identifier for the point at which a meter is, has been or will be connected to the Gas Network

uprn.description: Unique identifier for every addressable location in Great Britain

incoming_supplier.description: A unique three character code used to identify the Incoming Supplier

supply_point_withdrawal_status.description: Identifies if the site is not registered to a Shipper or the current Shipper has withdrawn

network_owner_effective_from_date.description: Date the network owner is effective from for a supply meter point

sms_operating_entity_efd.description: The date on which the Smart Meter System Operator (SMSO) becomes effective

dcc_service_flag_efd.description: The first inclusive calendar date for which the status of Data Communications Company (DCC) Service Flag applies

first_smets_installation_date.description: First Smart Metering Equipment Technical Specifications (SMETS) Installation Date

ihd_install_status.description: Information from the Supplier regarding the status/existence of the In Home Display (IHD) at a supply point

igt_transportation_charge_rate.description: The monetary rate that is applicable to the Supply Meter Point for IGT transportation charges

igt_transportation_charge_rate_type.description: Indicator showing the type of IGT Transportation Charge Rate being applied

igt_charging_methodology.description: The IGT charging methodology that is applied to the Supply Point

csep_supply_point_offtake_quantity.description: The daily offtake (SOQ) of gas (measured in kWh) of all Supply Points associated with the CSEP’s connection to the upstream network, calculated from the EUC AQ and DM SOQ information

previous_supplier_name.description: Name of the last previous Supplier assigned to the Supply Point

previous_supplier_short_code.description: Specifies the 3 digit unique Supplier Short Code for the previous Supplier

priority_consumers_indicator.description: The category of priority consumer at the Supply Meter Point

csep_max_annual_quantity.description: The total projected maximum annual offtake (AQ) of gas (measured in kWh) of all Supply Meter Points associated with this CSEP’s connection to the upstream network

original_supply_meter_point_annual_quant.description: The initial estimated Annual Quantity for the Supply Meter Point

csep_id.description: The unique identifier for the Connected System Exit Point (CSEP)

meter_imperial_indicator.description: Indicator identifying if the meter measures volume of gas consumed in metric or imperial units

meter_device_status.description: A code indicating the current status of the meter installed at the supply point

amr_sp.description: A unique three character code used to identify the Automated Meter Reading (AMR) Service Provider

interruption_contract_exists.description: Indicator to identify whether an Interruption Contract Exists on the supply meter point

installing_supplier_id.description: A unique three character code used to identify the Supplier responsible for the first SMETS Meter Installation at the supply point

mam_short_code.description: A unique three character code used to identify the Meter Asset Manager (MAM)

meter_number_of_dials.description: Number of dials or digits on the meter which are considered during meter reading

supply_meter_point_shq.description: Current Supply Meter Point SHQ (Standard Hourly Offtake Quantity)

address_id.description: Unique (Internal BDP) identifier for the address

class.description: Denotes the current class type for the Supply Meter Point. VALUES: 1 - Class 1, 2 - Class 2, 3 - Class 3, 4 - Class 4

current_supplier.description: A unique three character code used to identify the current supplier

current_supplier_name.description: Name of the current Supplier for the supply meter point

twin_stream_site_indicator.description: Indicates if the supply meter point is currently a twin stream site

ldz_id.description: Unique reference code for the Local Distribution Zone (LDZ)

market_sector_code.description: A code that specifies that the site is used for domestic or industrial and commercial purposes

meter_capacity.description: The amount of gas that can be passed through the meter in a given time period. This is the manufacturer's maximum value

meter_mechanism.description: The coded value of the description of the Meter Mechanism

meter_point_status.description: The current status of the operability of the supply meter point

annual_quantity.description: The current annual offtake quantity (AQ) of a Supply Meter Point. Value in kWh.

msn.description: The manufacturer's meter serial number as held on the physical meter currently installed on the supply point

formula_year_annual_quantity.description: The supply meter point AQ that is fixed throughout the formula year for determination of Transportation rates. Value in kWh

smso_id.description: The identity of the operator, a Supplier has procured data and communication services from, in respect of a Smart Metering System

meter_type.description:
The type of meter installed at the supply point. 
R = Rotary; T = Turbine; D = Diaphragm of unknown material; L = Leather Diaphragm; S = Synthetic Diaphragm; U = Ultrasonic;Z= Unknown; O = Orifice

formula_year_offtake_quantity.description: The current value for SOQ of the supply point that is fixed throughout the formula year for determination of transportation rates. Value in kWh

shipper_name.description: Name of the current Shipper assigned to the Supply Point

shipper_short_code.description: Specifies the 3 digit unique Shipper Short Code for the current Shipper

end_user_category_code.description: Acronym for the makeup of an End User Category (EUC). For example: EA:E1903B

confirmation_reference_number.description: A sequential number that uniquely identifies the Confirmation (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

confirmation_effective_date.description: Date on which the current Shipper took over responsibility for the Supply Point (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

meter_read_batch_frequency.description:
The frequency on which reads will be received for class 3 Supply Meter Points. 
VALUES: W-7 days, F –14 days, M –month, 6 –6 monthly. (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

supply_meter_point_current_year_minimum_.description: The minimum bookable annual capacity based on the historic maximum annual offtake for a Supply (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

meter_manufacturer.description: Identifies the Short code of meter manufacturer of the meter installed at theSupply Point (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

meter_installation_date.description: Date the meter was installed at the SupplyPoint (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

meter_units.description: This contains the units the meter installed on a Supply Point is reading in e.g. 10, 100, 1000 (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

meter_location.description:
A code representing the location of a meter installed at the Supply Point 
VALUES: 0 -Unknown, 1 -Cellar, 2 -Under Stairs, 3 -Hall, 4 -Kitchen, 5 -Bathroom, 6-Garage, 7 -Canteen, 8 -Cloakroom, 9 -Cupboard, 10 -Domestic, 11 -Front Door, 12 -Hall Cupboard, 13 -Kitchen Cupboard, 14 -Kitchen under the sink, 15 -Landing, 16 -Office, 17 -Office Cupboard, 18 -Outside WC, 19 -Pantry, 20 -Porch, 21 -Public Bar, 22 -Rear of Shop, 23 -Saloon Bar, 24 -Shed, 25 -Shop Front, 26 -Shop Window, 27 -Staff Room, 28 -Store Room, 29 -Toilet, 30 -Under Counter, 31 -Waiting Room, 32 -Meterbox, 98 –Other, 99–Outside (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

correction_factor.description: This is a fixed factor where no convertor is fitted and the meter reading needs to be corrected for Pressure/Altitude/Temperature. Format:999.999999 (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

gas_act_owner.description:
Unique code which identifies the role the market participant is acting in. 
Values : T -GAO Transporter , S -GAO Supplier , C -GAO Consumer, U –Unknown.

meter_asset_manager_effective_date.description: The date on which Meter Asset Manager (MAM) is effectively responsible for the meter assets at the Supply Point (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

meter_model.description: The model description of the meter installed at the Supply Point (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)

meter_year_of_manufacture.description: The year in which the meter installed at the Supply Point was manufactured expressed as a century date (e.g. 1981) (only visible where the Supply Point is within the requester's portfolio)ah

meter_link_code.description:
A code specifying the functional relationship between meters (the way in which they are linked together) at given locations on an End User's site to be described. 
VALUES: P = Primary Meter, S = Sub-meter, F = Free standing meter

end_user_category_identifier.description: A unique reference for the End User Category assigned to the Supply Point

smp_prospective_formula_year_soq.description: Prospective Formula Year SOQ value. ‘Prospective’ is a synonym for ‘Perspective’

smp_prospective_formula_year_aq.description: Prospective Formula Year AQ value. ‘Prospective’ is a synonym for ‘Perspective’

smp_prospective_formula_year_effective_d.description: Prospective Formula Year effective date. ‘Prospective’ is a synonym for ‘Perspective’

small_large_supply_point_indicator.description: Indicator showing if a Supply Point is Large(LSP) or Small (SSP) Annual Quantity threshold of 73,200 kWh

daily_metered_indicator.description:
Indicator showing if the Supply Meter Point is Daily Metered 
Values: Daily Metered, Non Daily Metered

convertor_indicator.description:
Indicator for the presence of a Converter Asset. 
Values: Y = Yes, N = NO

offtake_quantity.description: The current value for the peak daily supply offtake quantity (SOQ) of a supply point.Value in kWh
